latest_strategy_decision: Etsy shop access is necessary but not sufficient — re-diagnosed the actual bottleneck as the missing technical publish mechanism (no Etsy MCP/API integration existed) rather than the shop itself. Built that mechanism instead of asking the owner to paste the listing manually (would violate the standing 'not a copy/paste operator' rule and wasn't needed — an OAuth-token-based path is buildable). Kept existing content/pricing ($9) unchanged: no market evidence yet argues for a different price or offer, and changing it without evidence would be strategy churn, not decision-making.
latest_strategy_decision_ja: Etsyショップの権限だけでは出品できない、実際のボトルネックは技術的な出品手段の不在であったと再診断した。オーナーに手動貼り付けを依頼する（コピペオペレーター化の禁止ルールに反し、かつ必要でもない）代わりに、その手段自体を構築した。既存の内容・価格（$9）は根拠のある市場データが無い限り変更せず維持（証拠なき変更は戦略の迷走になるため）。

notes: OFFICIAL WINDOW OPENED 2026-09-01 (Asia/Tokyo). Official revenue ¥0, official cost ~¥60-210 so far (see cost_ledger.json). 2026-09-01T12:30 UTC: owner reported the Etsy shop is open (KYC/bank/card done) and delegated all listing/pricing/strategy decisions to the AI. Built the full mechanism this iteration: marketing/etsy_listing_config.json (content, reusing the already-prepared kit/images/ZIP unchanged -- no market evidence yet to justify changing price/copy), scripts/etsy_publish.mjs (Etsy API v3 create-draft -> upload images -> upload file -> activate, idempotent), scripts/etsy_oauth_setup.mjs (local one-time OAuth helper), .github/workflows/etsy-publish.yml (workflow_dispatch), ops/ETSY_API_SETUP.md (owner instructions, ~10-15 min). This is untested against the live Etsy API (no credentials or egress available in this session) -- documented honestly as an expected first-run iteration risk, not claimed as working. The Etsy OAuth token grant is now the true binding constraint on the next revenue milestone, replacing the resolved shop-KYC blocker; STRIPE_RESTRICTED_KEY and X API credentials remain correctly classified as optional (additional_permissions_requested) per the owner's earlier correction. Nothing has actually been listed on Etsy yet and no sale has occurred -- reporting this honestly, not as a completed launch.
